prompt:
Refine this SanForum.at mobile forum concept while preserving its exact portrait canvas, original logo and deep-blue header, all German content, equal Kategorien/Aktuell access, the current topic list, and #3877E5 accent. This is a working mobile Discourse interface, not a poster.

Change only the category-browsing section and its transition into recent topics. Replace the three bulky separate category cards and large square pictograms with one compact continuous white index panel. Present “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung”, and “Geräte, Fahrzeuge & Technik” as clear, ordinary category rows with modest metadata and conventional chevrons. Remove promotional descriptions and oversized pictograms from those rows. Use the recovered space to give categories and recent discussion comparable emphasis in the first viewport.

The direction’s single distinctive feature is an offset blue section tab projecting subtly from the left edge of this clean white reading panel. Label it “Rettungsdienst”; it is an orientation marker for this parent category and its training/equipment subcategories, not a new navigation control. The blue tab and blue-tinted ground should suggest an organized reference register without physical paper, punched holes, book edges, page textures or shadows. Retain readable neutral grotesk labels, regular web controls and the small “Beispielansicht” disclosure.
initial_prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile Discourse forum overview for SanForum.at, edge to edge in a portrait 390:844 viewport at high resolution, with crisp German text. No device frame, browser chrome, or desk. This is an everyday forum for Austria’s rescue-service community, where members browse categories and catch up on conversations with equal priority.

Use reference image 1 as the existing SanForum logo, preserving its entire mark and wordmark unchanged, original proportions, on a contrasting deep-blue header. References 2 and 3 are style inspiration adapted into a real working product; do not copy their layout, text, yellow/cream palette, or physical-book treatment. The fixed SanForum accent is #3877E5, supported by navy, cool blue-white and clean white.

The screen contains familiar menu, search and account controls; equally prominent “Kategorien” and “Aktuell” access; a compact category index; then recent topic rows and a clear “Neues Thema” button. Categories read “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung”, and “Geräte, Fahrzeuge & Technik”. Topics read “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung”, and “Monitoring im Vergleich”. Give one topic a clear unread indicator. Show modest sample reply counts and times, identified by a small “Beispielansicht” label; no personal photos or private usernames.

The single signature is an offset blue section tab locating the active category beside a clean white reading panel on a blue-tinted ground. Neutral grotesk labels and calm reading typography. All controls remain ordinary web controls. No simulated book, holes, page-turn effects, marketing hero, charts, giant headlines, or decorative cards.
